article.title: Improve Your Daily Driving
article.author: Tiqua Jackson
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. Browse any car accessories store and half the products claim to be life-changing. Most of it is genuinely just noise, gimmicky gadgets that sound impressive in a product listing and end up sitting unused in a glovebox within a fortnight. There’s a handful of auto accessories online that actually earn their place, and they’re usually the boring, practical ones nobody’s excited to talk about. A Proper Phone Mount This sounds basic. However, it can’t be just any kind of phone mount. You’ll need something that’s top-notch quality, but not necessarily expensive. What we mean by that is one with a suction mount that won’t lose grip on a hot day and won’t fall off in every bump. If the magnetic mount keeps on sliding off, it’s going to be a real distraction and a potential accident cause. Spending a bit more will sometimes save you from the trouble. But don’t forget to check for genuine feedback with photos and videos before checking out. Pick one that holds firm through corners and lumps. It also helps to make sure that it has an easy one-handed release. Genuinely Good Floor Mats Factory floor mats are often thin and next to useless once winter rolls around, and you’re tracking mud or wet grass into the car daily. Proper all-weather rubber mats with raised edges contain mess properly, and they’re genuinely easy to just pull out and hose off rather than trying to vacuum ground-in dirt out of carpet. This is one of those accessories that doesn’t sound exciting at all but makes a real, tangible difference to keeping a car’s interior in decent condition over years of regular use. A Dash Cam That’s Set Up Properly Dash cams have become common enough that plenty of people have one installed and forget about it entirely until they need the footage, only to discover it wasn’t recording properly, the memory card was full, or the angle wasn’t capturing what mattered. A properly set up dash cam, checked periodically to confirm it’s working, genuinely earns its place for the peace of mind alone in an at-fault dispute or insurance claim. The key word here is properly. A dash cam shoved in a drawer because the mount was fiddly to install isn’t providing any value at all. A Decent Boot Organiser For anyone regularly carrying groceries, tools, or gear that slides around the boot on every turn, a proper collapsible boot organiser keeps things contained and upright instead of tipping over and rolling around every time you brake or corner. It sounds minor until you’ve had a week of groceries sliding into every corner of the boot and back again. Useful Interior LED Lighting Factory interior lighting in a lot of cars is genuinely dim, barely enough to find something dropped in the footwell at night. A proper LED interior light upgrade, whether that’s replacing factory bulbs or adding a small additional light source, makes finding things in the car after dark noticeably easier without needing to fumble around with a phone torch. This isn’t about flashy underglow or colour-changing lights for the sake of it. It’s about being able to actually see what you’re looking for in the back seat at night, which is a small but genuinely useful upgrade over factory lighting in plenty of vehicles. A Quality Tyre Pressure Gauge Most people rely entirely on the dashboard warning light for tyre pressure. However, it only triggers once the pressure has dropped. Keep a proper gauge in the glovebox and check pressure every month to catch gradual pressure loss. This will detect problems well before the warning light comes on. It matters a lot for fuel efficiency and tyre wear over time.
